name: Erica
source: Erica is well-mannered and kind-hearted young woman, she respects authority and follows the rules, making her the complete opposite of Angelica. Though she dreams of becoming a child psychologist, her suppredssed attraction to strong, dominant men occasionally conflicts with her otherwise reserved nature.
